message.content:
This editorial illustration serves as a magazine cover with a red background. At the top, white text reads "KARAT PENYEBAB JATUHNYA AIRASIA" above a large, pink "TEMPO" logo. Smaller white text below says "7-13 DESEMBER 2015".

The illustration features several stylized male figures with blue skin in various martial arts poses. In the foreground, a man in a black suit with glasses and a mustache faces right, his hands raised. He faces a short man in a yellow jumpsuit who is surrounded by unspooled black magnetic tape. The yellow-clad man has a concentrated expression and holds his fists up.

Above them, more figures appear: one in a white shirt and black pants, another in a light blue shirt, and a larger figure in a red robe performing a flying kick. A dark, shadowy figure looms in the upper right corner.

Other elements include a reel-to-reel tape recorder wheel and a barcode in the bottom left corner with the price "RP 39.500". White headlines read "HAJAR! YANG MULIA" and additional smaller Indonesian text.
